title: torviello-landing deploy script interface
description: Interface of torviello-landing/deploy/deploy.sh: commands, flags, environment, exit codes, remote layout, and release identity. Consumers are operators, tests, and future CI automation. Changes to any field here are contract changes under GOV-08.

deploy.description: Build, stage with a SHA256SUMS manifest, upload into a new release directory, verify on the server, atomically repoint current, prune.

rollback.description: Verify the checksums of a previously uploaded release on the server, then atomically repoint current at it. Default target: the newest release that is not currently active.

flags.--dry-run: Local path runs in full; rsync gets --dry-run; no SSH command is issued, so remote state is never touched.
flags.--skip-build: Reuse the existing web/dist output (must contain index.html) instead of running bun run build.
flags.--host: user@host or host overriding LANDING_DEPLOY_HOST for this invocation.
flags.--keep: Retention count for deploy; 0 disables pruning. Overrides LANDING_DEPLOY_KEEP.
flags.--release-id: Override the release id (deterministic runs in tests and CI). Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$. Requires --skip-build to be reproducible.
flags.--into: rollback only: explicit target release id.

LANDING_DEPLOY_WEBROOT.description: Remote webroot containing releases/ and current. Must match ^[A-Za-z0-9/._-]+$ (shell-safe).

LANDING_DEPLOY_RELEASE_ID.description: Override the release id; otherwise YYYYmmddHHMMSS-<git-short-sha> (nogit suffix outside a git worktree).

LANDING_DEPLOY_SSH_OPTIONS.description: Extra options appended to every ssh invocation (e.g. -i keyfile -J bastion). Never store key material in the repository.

exit_codes.2: usage error: unknown command or flag, missing required environment, or unsafe webroot/release id
exit_codes.3: missing dependency: rsync, ssh, or bun (when building) not on PATH
exit_codes.4: build failed: bun run build exited non-zero
exit_codes.5: remote verification failed: checksum mismatch or missing index.html; current untouched
exit_codes.6: rollback target missing: no releases or unknown --into id
exit_codes.7: local artifact integrity failure: staging failed or --skip-build output missing index.html

invariants: release directories are never rewritten by a later deploy
current is replaced by rename (mv -T on GNU); platforms without mv -T fall back to rm+rename with a tiny non-atomic window
the release current points at is never pruned
activation happens only after on-server checksum verification plus index.html presence

verification_marker.description: Echoed by the on-server verification script after checksums validate and index.html is present; the script only activates a release whose verification output ends with this token.
